decision.summary: Only the E component exhibits a prolonged low-level plateau from 665 to 694, without matching N/U motion. The rise beginning ~690 does not complete a return to the original baseline before the end of the allowed context (729), and no opposing offset is confirmed. Thus, the interval is classified as uncertain.

intervals.observation: E-component shows a sustained depression (~2–3 MAD below prior baseline) from index 665 through 694, with no coherent shift in N or U. The E level begins rising sharply near 690–694 but does not return to the pre-665 baseline within the allowed context (ends at 729). Return is unobserved/ambiguous; status uncertain.
